observations: Photo 0: Back of a blue Samsung phone with a vertical quad-camera setup and a fingerprint sensor below. A white sticker with model and serial info is visible. The phone has a textured back with vertical lines. The Samsung logo is at the bottom.

Photo 2: Front of the phone showing the lock screen with time 4:03, date 21 September, and a colorful abstract wallpaper. The screen has a waterdrop notch. The phone is held in hand, showing the bezels and side profile.
The sticker on the back (photos 0 and 1) is partially legible. The model number appears to be SM-M325F/DS, which matches the Samsung Galaxy M32. The sticker also shows 'MADE IN INDIA'.

The rear camera module has four lenses, consistent with a quad-camera setup. The front camera is visible in the waterdrop notch in photo 2. However, megapixel counts cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

The phone appears to be in good condition with no visible cracks or major damage. However, internal functionality, battery health, and software performance cannot be verified remotely. Minor smudges or wear are visible on the back.
